sloka: न सुवर्णेन मे ह्यर्थो न रत्नैर्न च भूषणैः ।एष मे जीवितस्यान्तो रामो यद्यभिषिच्यते ॥२-९-५९॥
transliteration: na suvarṇena me hyartho na ratnairna ca bhūṣaṇaiḥ ।eṣa me jīvitasyānto rāmo yadyabhiṣicyate ॥2-9-59॥

translations.english: I do not aspire for gold, nor gems nor ornaments. If Rama is installed, that will be the end of my life.
